newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern optimistic on '97 growth.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern optimistic on '97 growth.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp on Wednesday said its financial outlook for 1997 was optimistic because of expected growth in both the United States and other markets.

Executive Vice President Leslie "Ike" Prillaman told analysts at a meeting to discuss the company's fourth-quarter results that growth would be driven in part by five new contracts cemented within 48 hours of one another in November. Those deals will contribute more than $140 million in revenue, he said.

Of the new projects cited, a 12-year contract with Ford Motor Co will result in an annual revenue increase of $105 million by 2000, he said. With the launch of the contract, slated for January 1998, Norfolk Southern will handle 70 percent of Ford's North American production.
